_doc: Every old/new reader difference contracts.replay may accept, and nothing else. A difference matches an entry only when family, input_class, old, old_exc, new and new_exc are ALL equal (input_class is computed by replay.input_class from the bytes; new_exc null = the new reader did not raise). Any other difference -- including a digest difference under equal decisions -- fails the replay (GPT review contracts #1, #4).

allow.why: json.loads raised RecursionError out of read_all; the line is now counted as unreadable (bad_out), like any other
RecursionError escaped audits.parse; now 'line N is not JSON' (ValueError, the reader's refusal)
RecursionError escaped arbiter_pending.read_jsonl; now its ValueError 'is not JSON' (the torn-store refusal)
RecursionError escaped `except ValueError` and crashed the dispatcher tick; the line is passed over like any unreadable ledger line (the ledger is not this reader's to refuse)
the shard was opened strict UTF-8: one bad byte crashed the tick; now read with errors=replace and that line is passed over
ev.get on a non-object crashed the tick; the line is passed over
a truthy non-string ts compared with a str raised TypeError and crashed the tick; the event is passed over
res.get on a non-object result crashed drain_outbox; it is now left in the worker outbox, unkept
a tagged result missing outcome/cause/attempt crashed collect with KeyError; it is now recorded INVALID/HARNESS with the reason (TESTQ_OUTCOME_HARDEN_TAG_ONLY_KEYERROR)

a tagged result that breaks testq.result/1 was used as written; it is now replaced by an INVALID/HARNESS record carrying the reason, so the stored digest differs (TESTQ_OUTCOME_HARDEN_TAG_ONLY_KEYERROR)
a non-object worker line crashed reconcile with AttributeError; remote() now returns an error object and the unreadable branch logs it (TESTQ_HARDEN_RECONCILE_NONDICT_CRASH)
